removal.definition: causal contribution of a family = net − net of the same configuration rerun in the pool with that family disabled

matched.method: Priority 2's matchLots (post.ts): unchanged, resized, retimed exit, retimed, newly admitted, displaced; Σ Δ reconciles to Δ net

neighbourhood.instrument: Priority 2's qualifyMembers (src/vgt-d1-growth-joint/qualify.ts) with cutoff label C24; radii, rounding, clipping and statistics of PROTOCOL.md §6.1 there

subjects.use: report-only neighbourhood of the primary diagnostic pair
reproduction check of the instrument: every statistic must equal Priority 2's sealed C24 evidence

neighbourhood.statistics: median, p10, p90 of net; robust = ½ median + ½ p10; median, p90 and worst DD; breach share (DD > $35,000), mean excess; mixed share; distinct ledgers; draws equal to the centre; clipping
neighbourhood.reused: comparators' neighbourhoods are Priority 2's sealed C24 evidence (results/folds/C24/selection.json), not recomputed
neighbourhood.noValidationSweep: no validation (FULL) perturbation of the pair is run (brief)

noSelection: Nothing here selects, ranks for selection, replaces or relabels a configuration. The six cases, the comparators and every neighbour are reported only; Priority 2's frozen selection and primary are unchanged.
doors: D24 and FULL open only after this manifest is sealed and committed unchanged (guard); every opening is logged in results/doors.jsonl
